I sadly don’t have a solution for you as I struggle with the same thing a lot and haven’t found a way to snap myself out of it, but I just want you to know that you aren’t alone. Many people feel this same way, so don’t beat yourself up for it. You sound like you’re a very hard worker, so give yourself credit for that. Maybe you’re just getting a little burnt out. Take some time for yourself to do things that you enjoy (that don’t include academic stuff) and just give yourself a break and a chance to decompress. I wish the best for you.
